sources.title: The Rise of Linear Attention in Bidirectional Modeling and Long-Term ...
sources.snippet: The takeaway: unlike prior linear approximations that traded away learning quality to hit linear complexity, LinRec’s careful reconstruction of the attention conditions — reordering, dual normalization, and non-linearity — preserves the mathematical properties that made dot-product attention effective, while still running in linear time.
